category: Avyaya — the indeclinable and the adverb
label: time deictics: now, today, yesterday, tomorrow, the day after
note: idānīm, adya, hyaḥ, śvaḥ and paraśvaḥ. The set is unusually complete — Sanskrit gives the day after tomorrow its own word, and chapter 4 teaches śvaḥ inside the leave-taking that needs it.
